files.citation: Same dataset family as GHS-UCDB R2024A (see above); GHS_UCDB_MTUC_GLOBE_R2024A is the multi-temporal-boundary companion product.

notes: Both files are well under the 500MB authorized-download threshold (prompt Section 3). No global raster stack (GHS-BUILT-S/BUILT-V/POP grids, MODIS/VIIRS, ERA5, DEM, flood) was downloaded in this execution. Raw files are stored unmodified under data/raw/ and are excluded from git version control per .gitignore; derived/processed tables are stored separately under data/interim/ and results/1005-4/.
